scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run deps:go
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait db
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U hackertracker -d hackertracker
scripts.dev: concurrently -n vite,go -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm run dev:go"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm run build:go
